page.overview:
Who is Annie?

Annie was the last survivor in Lisa's ant farm.

After Bart accidentally destroyed Lisa's ant farm Annie was the only surviving ant. Annie became weaker and could only carry thirty times her own weight when Bart and Lisa decided to let her out into the wild after Lisa suspected that she had only two or three days to go in life. Right after Bart and Lisa released to the nature, she was eaten by Santa's Little Helper.

Annie is a reference to Little Orphan Annie. [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Little_Orphan_Annie]
